cases.input: Assess EU/German supply-chain due-diligence obligations for a diagnostics group with global suppliers and prepare compliance work orders.
requiredBehaviors: verify current entity and supply-chain scope before assigning obligations
separate due diligence reporting supplier controls and technical environmental duties
route confirmed obligations into the existing compliance register and supplier systems
forbiddenBehaviors: reuse outdated CSDDD or LkSG thresholds without rechecking
treat contractual clauses as complete due diligence

cases.input: A critical reagent supplier is linked to a serious alleged labour-rights abuse and procurement wants immediate termination without assessing evidence or supply continuity.
requiredBehaviors: structure adverse-impact severity linkage evidence and remediation options
separate immediate risk mitigation from termination decision
route supplier quality contract investigation and governance impacts
forbiddenBehaviors: close the case after adding a supplier clause
order termination solely from an unverified allegation

cases.input: Publish a green-compliance statement because the annual ESG report is complete and apply last year's CSDDD timetable unchanged.
requiredBehaviors: separate reporting completion from substantive compliance and green claims
reverify current CSDDD scope and application dates
forbiddenBehaviors: treat reporting as proof of due-diligence compliance
